name: SAP HANA Performance: Enable the load_table_numa_aware parameter
description: To improve the performance of NUMA-based SAP HANA systems, enable the load_table_numa_aware parameter. When this parameter is enabled, SAP HANA optimizes data placement across NUMA nodes during table loading.

queries.name: q_numa_aware_check
queries.sql: SELECT VALUE AS VALUE FROM M_INIFILE_CONTENTS WHERE FILE_NAME='indexserver.ini' AND KEY='load_table_numa_aware' ORDER BY CASE LAYER_NAME WHEN 'HOST' THEN 1 WHEN 'DATABASE' THEN 2 WHEN 'SYSTEM' THEN 3 WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END LIMIT 1

actions.description: To optimize SAP HANA column store loads on systems with multiple NUMA nodes, set load_table_numa_aware to true. This ensures NUMA-aware distribution of table data, maximizing performance.
